newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales to total $2.77 bln week of Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales to total $2.77 bln week of Sept 9.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $2.77 billion in 105 offerings for the week of September 9, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales for the week are expected to total about $1.1 billion in 66 offerings. The largest is a $115.2 million Wisconsin general obligation deal set for Sept 11.

Negotiated sales, depending on market conditions, could total $1.67 billion in 39 offerings for the week. The largest issue is expected to be a $325 million Washington Public Power Supply System refunding deal through Goldman Sachs & Co.
Another $1.3 billion of deals are on the Reuters day-to-day negotiated calendar, meaning underwriters may decide to price the issues depending on market conditions.
